build_flamingo_model: build a Flamingo multimodal model with vision encoder, language encoder, and tokenizer configs
predict_image_caption: predict image captions using the Flamingo model with zero-shot or few-shot inference
extract_vision_features: extract vision features from input images using the Flamingo vision encoder and perceiver resampler
preprocess_text_prompts: preprocess text prompts for zero-shot or few-shot inference by formatting and tokenizing them
post_process_outputs: post process generated outputs to extract captions or VQA answers from Flamingo model predictions
